preconditions.description: The number of operations is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each operation type is between 1 and 3, inclusive.
The integer x_i in operation type 1 is within the range of -1000 to 1000, inclusive.
The integer a_i in operation type 1 is at least 1.
The integer k_i in operation type 2 is within the range of -1000 to 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: There will always be at least one element in the sequence.
preconditions.description: The sequence will always have at least one element after any operation.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, each with the average of the numbers in the sequence after the corresponding operation.
The output's average must have an absolute or relative error not exceeding 10^{-6} compared to the actual average after each operation.
